repair.content:
For fixed W' satisfying strict intersection contraction, at most one lift concentrated on P(W') minus P(W' intersect W), conditional on existence. Carrier only contained in W'.

Require strong irreducibility of rho(Gamma_mu),rho'(Gamma_mu), or specify actual support Zariski closure in applicable setting.

Approximate by finite support words returning to identity component; split at first return blocks; each block in supp(mu^tau) by positive open-neighborhood probability and locally constant finite coset itinerary; take products and closure.

Normalize A by |det A|^(-1/d). Normalized projective compact closure has bounded singular values and inverse, is compact group; average inner product; scalar rescaling preserves invariant complements.
